review.tagline: Stateful agent harness with git-tracked memory, channels and remote computers
review.summary: Letta Code is an npm-installed agent harness whose agents keep memory blocks, skills and prompts in a git-tracked MemFS and rewrite them over time. Agents run from a CLI, desktop app, browser (chat.letta.com) or Telegram, Slack and Discord channels, use subagents, hooks and cron schedules, and can run on remote machines via letta server. Letta Cloud is the default backend; local is available.
review.audience: Developers who want agents that keep learning across sessions and devices
strengths: All agent context including memory blocks is versioned in git (MemFS)
Same agent reachable from CLI, desktop, browser, Telegram, Slack and Discord
Skills installable from GitHub, ClawHub or the Hermes Skills Hub
Apache-2.0; Nix flake and AUR packages available
weaknesses: Letta Cloud is the default; remote computers and secrets require signing in
Self-hosted app server setup is not described in the README; local backend only mentioned
AgentFile export/import removed; agent registry imports no longer supported
Automatic dreaming is disabled on native Windows by default
needs: Models: OpenAI / ChatGPT, Anthropic, Z.ai coding plan
